clue.text: Pompous talk has to fail badly since having little time

parts.note: a show that bombs flops completely
as can mean because or since
T is the standard abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: Someone's pretentious speech collapses because they ran short of time.
explanation.definitionFit: Inflated, high-sounding language with little substance is a synonym for pompous talk.

clue.text: Plant left out of bed, then put in

parts.note: someone who is up has got out of bed
something put in is in, as a ball in play or a candidate elected

explanation.surface: A gardener lifts a plant from its bed and then replants it.
explanation.definitionFit: A tall flowering garden plant of the pea family is one example of a plant.

clue.text: Do as the Queen does, being good in horse control

indicators.note: the letter for good sits within the word for the horse's strap

parts.note: a rein is the strap used to guide a horse

explanation.surface: The monarch shows her skill with the reins while riding.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruling as sovereign is what a monarch does, so the verb fits the definition's paraphrase.

clue.text: Exceed budget moving front of Kent port's enclosure to the east

indicators.note: moving says one letter of the built phrase is shifted to another spot
front of picks out the opening letter of the port's name as the one that moves
in an across entry east is the right-hand end, where the moved letter goes

parts.note: Dover is the Channel port in Kent; the possessive adds S
a pen is an enclosure for animals

explanation.surface: Instructions for relocating the entrance to a pen at a Kent harbour.
explanation.walkthrough: DOVER'S PEN has its initial D moved to the end, giving OVERSPEN + D.
explanation.definitionFit: To spend more than planned is to go beyond, or exceed, a budget.

clue.text: Small living space is excessive in prison

indicators.note: in places the abbreviation for excessive within the word for prison

parts.note: a cage is a place of confinement
OTT is short for over the top, meaning excessive

explanation.surface: A complaint that a tiny cell is overkill for a jail.
explanation.definitionFit: A small house in the country is a modest living space.

clue.text: European old money starts English school

indicators.note: the European coin piece comes first, starting off ahead of the English letter

parts.note: a ducat was a gold coin used in Europe in past centuries

explanation.surface: A rich foreign investor's old fortune funds the founding of an English school.
explanation.definitionFit: To school someone is to teach or train them, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Novel kind of inducement

definitions.meaning: the title of Jane Austen's last completed novel
coaxing someone round by argument is a form of inducement

explanation.definitionFit: Coaxing by reasoning is a kind of inducement, and the word is also an Austen title.

clue.text: Optical glass that's new, introduced by the French

indicators.note: the letter for new is brought into the French article

parts.note: les is the French plural definite article

explanation.surface: A new optical glass has been brought in by French manufacturers.
explanation.definitionFit: A piece of shaped glass that focuses light is the optical glass described.

clue.text: Abandoning top of aircraft holding pattern, change course

indicators.note: the first letter of the holding-pattern word is dropped

parts.note: a stack is the layered circuit of planes waiting to land

explanation.surface: A pilot leaves the queue of circling planes and turns away.
explanation.definitionFit: In sailing, to tack is to change direction by turning into the wind.

clue.text: One tearing about with a group of similar age

indicators.note: tearing about suggests wild movement, so these letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone races around with a crowd of peers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tearing' does double duty in the surface but only its letters count; 'about' is the anagram signal, rearranging ONE TEARING.
explanation.definitionFit: A cohort of people born around the same time is a generation.

clue.text: Keep out of sight one time during short visit

indicators.note: during puts the word for one time inside the shortened visit
short says the word for visit loses its last letter

parts.note: to call on someone is to visit
once means on one occasion

explanation.surface: Someone hides on a single occasion during a brief stopover.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short' trims the last letter of the visit word, and 'during' puts the one-time word inside what is left.
explanation.definitionFit: To conceal something is to hide it, keeping it out of view.

clue.text: Filler hardened around aluminium article

indicators.note: the word for hardened wraps around the other pieces

parts.note: concrete that has set has hardened
Al is the chemical symbol for aluminium
an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: Putty that has set firm around an aluminium object.
explanation.definitionFit: A substance used to fill and seal gaps is a filler.

clue.text: Fish beside Norfolk waterways barrage

indicators.note: the fish is placed next to the waterways, after them

parts.note: the Broads are a network of rivers and lakes in Norfolk, eastern England
the ide is a freshwater fish

explanation.surface: Anglers fish along the Norfolk Broads near a dam.
explanation.definitionFit: A broadside is a heavy volley or onslaught, as is a barrage, of guns or of criticism.

clue.text: Key opening game, perhaps

parts.note: E is a musical key
a vent is an opening for air or gas

explanation.surface: The decisive opening move of a match.
explanation.definitionFit: A game is an example of a sporting event, hence 'perhaps'.

clue.text: North-eastern railway crossing very close to the edge?

indicators.note: the railway abbreviation goes across, enclosing the letter for very

explanation.surface: A railway line in the north-east runs perilously near a cliff edge.
explanation.definitionFit: Being on edge, jittery and anxious, is the punning sense of the definition.

clue.text: Hospital department of poor quality displaying lack of order

parts.note: ENT is the ear, nose and throat department
ropy is British slang for shoddy or poor

explanation.surface: A badly run hospital department showing chaos.
explanation.definitionFit: In physics, a measure of disorder in a system; generally, a lack of order.

clue.text: Result of friction with a second-rate celebrity

definitions.meaning: a bubble on the skin caused by rubbing
a ... is a minor celebrity, below the A-list

explanation.definitionFit: A skin swelling raised by rubbing; read with a hyphen it is a minor star.

clue.text: Romeo, say, shown as upper-class in highly cut film

indicators.note: in places the upper-class letter inside the word for the film

parts.note: a montage is a film sequence made of many short edited shots

explanation.surface: A posh young lover features in a heavily edited movie.
explanation.definitionFit: Romeo belongs to the Verona family in Shakespeare's play, so he is an example.

clue.text: Fuss over short-tailed bee is building

indicators.note: in a down entry the fuss sits above the insect piece

parts.note: ado means fuss or bother

indicators.note: short-tailed means the last letter is cut off

parts.note: taken as the insect word

explanation.surface: A commotion about a stingless insect constructing a hive.
explanation.definitionFit: Sun-dried clay brick, or a building made of it, as in the American Southwest.

clue.text: Thus raced about in this location loudly

indicators.note: the word for raced goes around the other two pieces

parts.note: tore means rushed or raced
here means in this place
F, for forte, is the musical direction loudly

explanation.surface: A sentence describing someone noisily dashing around a place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' means the raced word is split open to hold the location word plus F; 'loudly' is not a sound cue here but the musical forte.
explanation.definitionFit: A logical connective meaning consequently or so, synonymous with thus.

clue.text: Large tree erected in a temporary arrangement

parts.note: the ash is a common tree
something erected is put up

explanation.surface: A big tree is put up as a stopgap structure.
explanation.definitionFit: A makeshift contraption is a hastily rigged, provisional arrangement.

clue.text: Pressure to tell bishop?

parts.note: P is the symbol for pressure
to relate is to tell a story

explanation.surface: Someone is urged to inform the bishop.
explanation.definitionFit: A senior clergyman such as an archbishop or abbot; a bishop is an example, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Gently encourage going naked around grounds, initially

indicators.note: the word for naked surrounds the initial letter

parts.note: nude means without clothes

indicators.note: initially takes the first letter of grounds

explanation.surface: Naturists are coaxed to strip off around the estate.
explanation.definitionFit: A gentle push or prod to encourage someone is a nudge.

clue.text: Impractical combination of illegal drugs

parts.note: crack is a form of cocaine
pot is slang for cannabis

explanation.surface: A warning about mixing two banned narcotics.
explanation.definitionFit: Used adjectivally, a crackpot scheme is wildly unrealistic and impractical.

clue.text: What generates multiple reports of sulphur and infernal flames

parts.note: S is the chemical symbol for sulphur
hell is the inferno itself
fire means flames

explanation.surface: A description of brimstone and the fires of the underworld.
explanation.definitionFit: Artillery bombardment makes repeated loud bangs, the 'reports' of guns.

clue.text: Ultimate importance of mutating city ants

indicators.note: mutating means changing form, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: The supreme significance of insects evolving in a town.
explanation.definitionFit: Inviolability, being too sacred to be compromised, gives something paramount importance.

clue.text: A particular friend, a judge, sent back hot pepper

indicators.note: sent back says the whole string is read backwards

parts.note: a particular one is one, as in 'that one'
a pal is a friend

explanation.surface: A special friend who is a judge returns some chilli.
explanation.walkthrough: ONE PAL A J reversed gives J-A-LAP-ENO.
explanation.definitionFit: A Mexican green chilli is a variety of hot pepper.

clue.text: Feature on map going around to south of Cape

indicators.note: in a down entry the travelling phrase sits below the cape letter

parts.note: a band on tour is going around the country

explanation.surface: A traveller heads south of a headland, noting map features.
explanation.definitionFit: A line on a map joining points of equal height is a contour.

clue.text: I am upset with grey pictures

indicators.note: upset means overturned, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone is distressed by drab, colourless images.
explanation.definitionFit: Visual images collectively, or descriptive language evoking them, are pictures.

clue.text: He had certainly divided by an unknown prime

indicators.note: the unknown letter splits the other letters apart

parts.note: he had contracts to he'd
Y is a mathematical unknown
ay is an old affirmative, yes certainly

explanation.surface: A mathematician's claim about dividing by an unknown prime number.
explanation.definitionFit: One's prime is the peak period of success, one's heyday.

clue.text: Taxi home offers modest accommodation

parts.note: a cab is a taxi
being in means being at home

explanation.surface: A taxi to a house that offers simple lodgings.
explanation.definitionFit: A small hut or a ship's sleeping room is basic accommodation.

clue.text: W—H—E—A—T?

parts.note: a word written out letter by letter has been spelled out, and the word itself names a grain

explanation.definitionFit: An ancient species of wheat bears the same name as the past tense of spell.
